checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Frames at 0.6 s to 5.7 s are 826x496, about 5:3, the same shape as the 640x384 picture. That is close to 16:9. Playback and exact length cannot be confirmed from stills.

must.item: Lighthouse stripes, rocky coast and composition match the first-turn picture
must.why: The red-white-red tower, grassy base, rocky jetty and sky layout match the picture. The rocks shift slightly and the frame is a little cropped.

must.item: Watercolor look and dusk lighting remain throughout
must.why: Paper texture and washes persist. The sky darkens toward violet and orange by 5.7 s. It stays painterly, with a little muddiness.

must.item: Waves visibly move against the rocks and a beam sweeps across the water
must.why: Splashes and swells change visibly between frames. The 'beam' is only a glowing blob at the lantern that drifts left and right in the sky. No beam crosses the water.

must.item: No added writing or audible sound
must.why: No text is visible in any frame. Audio cannot be heard from stills, but the video was requested silent.

faults.what: The lighthouse beam is a glowing blob that appears to the left and right of the lantern in the sky. It is not a sweeping beam across the water, so the key requested motion is missing.
The rocks and the tower shift or rescale slightly relative to the source picture. The frame is cropped slightly.
The sky darkens and turns muddy by the end, with some AI-video softness.
The agent could not check the clip, so it did not catch the beam problem.

summary: The video keeps the watercolor lighthouse scene and shows lively waves on the rocks, but the beam is a glowing blob in the sky and never sweeps across the water.
